# 7405 - Hex inverter with open collector output

Package DIP-14 · family 74 · catalogue file [catalog/chips/7405.json](https://github.com/RetroCoreLabs/RetroSchematic/blob/master/src/catalog/chips/7405.json)

## Symbol

| As printed in ND-13.003.01, page 5 | Drawn in ND style | Drawn in modern style |
|---|---|---|
| ![7405 as printed in the 1976 symbol manual](../../../catalog/symbols/nd1976/7405.png) | ![7405 drawn in nd style](../../../catalog/symbols/nd1976/shapes/not-oc1.png) | ![7405 drawn in modern style](../../../catalog/symbols/modern/shapes/not-oc1.png) |

A narrow upright rectangle with ONE diagonal, from the bottom left corner to the middle of the right edge. No triangle.

How to tell it on a drawing: Single diagonal, no triangle = open-collector inverter. Compare 7404 (two lines forming a triangle).

All symbols: [symbol catalogue](../../SYMBOL-CATALOG.md).

## Functions

| Output pin | Formula | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| 2 | 1Y = NOT 1A | 1Y is the inverse of 1A. Open collector: the high level needs an outside pull-up. |
| 4 | 2Y = NOT 2A | 2Y is the inverse of 2A. Open collector: the high level needs an outside pull-up. |
| 6 | 3Y = NOT 3A | 3Y is the inverse of 3A. Open collector: the high level needs an outside pull-up. |
| 8 | 4Y = NOT 4A | 4Y is the inverse of 4A. Open collector: the high level needs an outside pull-up. |
| 10 | 5Y = NOT 5A | 5Y is the inverse of 5A. Open collector: the high level needs an outside pull-up. |
| 12 | 6Y = NOT 6A | 6Y is the inverse of 6A. Open collector: the high level needs an outside pull-up. |

## Electrical

| Value | Figure |
|---|---|
| outputLowMaxCurrentMa | 16 |
| outputMaxVoltageV | 5.5 |
| inputSchmitt | no |
| notes | Open collector: no IOH figure applies; the datasheet gives an off-state leakage of max 0.25 mA at VOH 5.5 V instead. |

## Propagation delays

| From | To | Edge | Typ ns | Max ns | Conditions |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| any | Y | PLH | 40 | 55 | VCC 5 V, TA 25 C, RL 4 kohm, CL 15 pF |
| any | Y | PHL | 8 | 15 | VCC 5 V, TA 25 C, RL 400 ohm, CL 15 pF |

## Notes

The datasheet gives no minimum propagation delay; minNs is null (the path-delay function uses 0 ns). No setup/hold/pulse-width limits apply to a gate, so timingLimits is empty.

## Sources

- [TI SN7405/SN74LS05/SN74S05 datasheet SDLS030A](https://www.ti.com/lit/ds/symlink/sn7405.pdf) - 1, 4; SN7405
